title: Guitar
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Guitar body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='24' ry='20' fill='#C8461E'/>
  <!-- Body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#E06A2E'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='66' r='7' fill='#3B1A0A'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='66' r='5' fill='#0D0A1A'/>
  <!-- Sound hole ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='66' r='7' fill='none' stroke='#F5C542' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <rect x='44' y='14' width='12' height='36' rx='2' fill='#8B5E34'/>
  <!-- Neck lighter stripe -->
  <rect x='46' y='14' width='3' height='36' fill='#B07A48'/>
  <!-- Fretboard -->
  <rect x='45' y='14' width='10' height='36' rx='1' fill='#4A2B15'/>
  <!-- Frets -->
  <line x1='45' y1='22' x2='55' y2='22' stroke='#D4B896' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='45' y1='30' x2='55' y2='30' stroke='#D4B896' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='45' y1='38' x2='55' y2='38' stroke='#D4B896' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='45' y1='45' x2='55' y2='45' stroke='#D4B896' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Headstock -->
  <rect x='42' y='4' width='16' height='12' rx='3' fill='#6B4226'/>
  <!-- Tuning pegs -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='7' r='2' fill='#F0D060'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='13' r='2' fill='#F0D060'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='7' r='2' fill='#F0D060'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='13' r='2' fill='#F0D060'/>
  <!-- Strings -->
  <line x1='47' y1='12' x2='47' y2='66' stroke='#FFF6D8' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='49' y1='12' x2='49' y2='66' stroke='#FFF6D8' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='51' y1='12' x2='51' y2='66' stroke='#FFF6D8' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='12' x2='53' y2='66' stroke='#FFF6D8' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <!-- Bridge -->
  <rect x='43' y='76' width='14' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#4A2B15'/>
  <!-- Bridge highlight -->
  <rect x='43' y='76' width='14' height='1.5' rx='1' fill='#7A5030'/>
  <!-- Pickguard -->
  <path d='M58 56 Q66 60 64 72 Q60 80 54 78 Z' fill='#2E1A0E' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- Small sparkle on body -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='62' r='1.2' fill='#FFE98A'/>
</svg>
